title: Short item on the Seoul Marathon inside the report 'Tesfay goes No.2 all time with 2:10:51 marathon debut in Barcelona'

story.W: Haven Hailu Desse pulled away after 35 km and ran alone to win in 2:19:09, 30 seconds ahead of Bekelech Gudeta. Halfway was 1:08:42.
story.M: Getaneh Molla led the closing stages, but Haftu Teklu passed him with a late kick to win by one second in a course record. Five men finished inside the old course record of 2:04:43. The report's times are one second slower than the stored results for the top two.

performances.name: Haftu TEKLU
performances.note: Retained his title in a personal best and course record, outkicking Molla late.

performances.name: Getaneh MOLLA
performances.note: Led the closing stages but was passed near the finish and beaten by one second.

performances.name: Haven Hailu DESSE
performances.note: Won by running alone from 35 km.

performances.name: Joyce Chepkemoi TELE
performances.note: Fourth in 2:19:50, breaking 2:20 for the first time.
